name: clickable
title: Clickable
description: The button surface — Button, Link and ExternalLink under one namespace. Three orthogonal axes (variant: solid/ghost/outline/icon, size: sm/md, shape: auto/square), none of which is colour. Tone arrives as a palette class. Link is a plain <a>; consumers stitch a router link through render. ExternalLink is a separate export for its outbound defaults.
